spec: Near-black rectangle on light, or near-white on dark, radius 6-10, 32-40px tall, 14/500, 12-16px side padding, no shadow. Label alone or with a 10px chevron. Hover steps the fill 150ms, about +11 L* on dark and -4 L* on white. The same button sits in nav and hero.

Full pill in the page's strongest neutral: near-black on light, off-white on dark, never pure white on pure black. 40-48px tall, 14-16px at 500, 20-24px side padding, no shadow. Usually the only filled object on screen. Use #e5e5e6 rather than #fff on near-black, stepping to white on hover.

One saturated brand fill on a near-square rectangle, radius 2-6, no shadow or gradient. 40px at 14/400 in nav, 48px at 16/400 in hero, 20-24px padding, small trailing chevron. Use white or dark text by contrast. Nothing else on the page uses this colour, so it reads as the action.

Flat saturated pill, 40-52px tall, 16/500, 24px side padding, no shadow, optional small arrow. Friendly and familiar, so it needs a confident colour. One fill per page, echoed once in a tag or highlight. Darken about 8 L on hover. Dark text on light accents, white on deep ones.

Small pill that repeats on every card: 33px tall, radius 16.5, 15px at weight 425, 16px side padding, 10px trailing chevron, 300ms transition. Low height keeps it product-like rather than marketing-loud, so it can sit under rates and tables. The chevron grows a stem on hover.

Radius 0 to 2, solid ink or a single brand colour, 40-52px tall, 16px sentence-case or 13-14px caps at 500-700, 16-24px padding. No icon, no shadow. Corners match tiles and rows, so it reads as one more piece of the grid. Inverts to white on photography.

Monospace uppercase label on a charcoal or black block, 36-41px tall, radius 0-8, 12-14px at 300-500, tracking 0.05-0.1em, 16-24px padding. Text in light grey rather than white. An ASCII > replaces the arrow. Square corners and mono make the control read as engineering, not marketing.

A short word in a wide box: 280-300px by 52-58px, radius 0 or full, 12-14px caps tracked 0.1-0.2em, centred. Width is fixed and ignores the label, which feels like print. Suits fashion, hospitality, museums and outdoor brands. Avoid on product pages, where it reads as slow.

Dark chip with one inner top highlight: 36px, radius 12, 14/500, 14px padding, fill about #242424, 1px border in the fill's own colour so inset 0 1px 0 white at 16% sits one pixel inside the edge. Trailing 12px chevron. On press the light inverts to black at 8%.

Light keycap on a dark page: 36px, radius 8, fill #e6e6e6, 14/500 dark label, leading 16px icon, 12px padding. Outer 2px ring in black at 50%, 14px white glow at 19%, inset -1px black at 20%. Hover steps to pure white and swaps to inset highlights in 200ms. Only one per view.

Saturated fill lit from inside: 44-48px, radius 8-14, 15/550. A lighter inset glow, inset 0 6px 14px at about 48% of a paler tint, or a 1px lighter top edge, plus a tinted drop shadow 0 2px 6px -1px. No visible gradient banding. Reads as glass or enamel, not as a flat web button.

A physical key: warm saturated face, solid darker lip 3-4px tall under it, no blur, radius 6-16, 44-50px, bold 16-18px dark label. Build the lip as box-shadow 0 4px 0 or inset 0 -3px 0. Press drops the face onto the lip. Secondary repeats it in white with a grey lip.

Solid shelf with no blur: 48-62px, 1.5px dark stroke, 4-8px hard offset in a darker tone, bold 16px label, uppercase with wide tracking. Moves onto its shelf when pressed. Printed and playful. Suits illustrated, health, education and consumer brands. One shadow colour across the page.

Pale brand fill inside a heavy ink stroke: 2px near-black border, radius 2-8, 44-52px, 16/600, 14-24px padding, no shadow. Same object in nav, hero and closing band. Comic and warm without being loud. Keep the fill light and the stroke the darkest thing on the page.

Dark pill wrapped by a detached colour ring: 48px, 16/600, 28px padding, box-shadow 0 0 0 4px in a pale brand tint, tight to the edge. The ring is the only bright colour above the fold and marks every primary action. A bigger version adds two faint concentric rings at 16 and 32px.

Neutral pill with a thin multi-hue stroke: 44-56px, full radius, 1.5-2px gradient border running around the perimeter, dark or white fill, 16-18/600 label. Colours come from the page art. Same treatment in nav, hero and close. Keep saturation in the stroke only, never in the fill.

Label plus a separate arrow shape: a 32-40px disc or tile holding a thin arrow, nested 4px inside the right end, or a twin disc touching the pill. 40-56px tall, 14-20px label. Hover moves only the chip. Two shapes reading as one gives a plain pill its own identity.

A plain control carrying one owned glyph instead of an arrow: a 6-12px solid dot left of the label, a stepped pixel chevron, a tilted product icon. 40-56px, neutral or brand fill. The glyph repeats in lists and links, so one small mark does the work of a logo.

Square block with one cut corner: 36-52px, black fill, 14-15/600, arrow icon, 8px diagonal clip at top right using clip-path, or an edge sliced about 15 degrees. The same cut appears on code blocks and panels, so it reads as a brand mark. One accent instance per group.

The control carries a fact as well as a verb: a price in the label or 16px beside it, a status such as Sold Out, a 15px fulfilment note beneath, a mono second line, or a 64px face. Same shape in every state, 41-64px. Use it where buying or trust is the question.

Pricing columns where only one button is filled: every button full column width at 36-44px and 14-16px, all white with 1px line or a stone tint, except the recommended plan in solid ink. No badge or accent needed, since one dark control steers the choice.

A button that teaches its shortcut: 32-36px, radius 4, 14px label, then an 18-20px inset square keycap holding one letter, 1px lighter outline, 8px after the label. Works only if the shortcut really works. Suits tools people use daily, in nav and hero. Add a lower lip for depth.

Main action plus a separate chevron cell for platform or method: same height, 1px seam in the page colour, chevron cell 28-36px wide, radius only on the outer corners. Clicking the label runs the default. Use when one verb has real alternatives, such as an OS download.

The button sized to the headline, not to the UI: 60-96px tall, label 20-53px, full pill or block, one per screen. It reads as a second headline or a game control. Use for launches, single-product and brand pages. Keep it large on phones. Light weights hold up at this size.

An action fixed to the viewport for the whole scroll: a 34-48px bar centred 24px above the bottom edge, or a corner block 16px in. Same label in every chapter. Inverts by section so it never disappears. Use on long stories and one-goal sites. Hide it near the page's own closing action.

On a dark page, no bright button at all: 36-48px, radius 6-16, fill white at 5-8%, 1px light line at 12-19%, 14-16/500 near-white. Quieter than the headline, so the darkness stays unbroken and the control reads as lit glass. Hover raises fill and border together.

Standing control with a pale edge: transparent or white, 1px at 10-15% ink, radius 6-10, 26-36px tall, 13-14/500 ink label, optional 12px arrow. No shadow. Use for See more, Log in and every action under a section heading. Hover darkens the border or adds a 4% fill.

1px full-ink stroke, radius 0-2, no fill, 40-48px tall, 16px label inset 16px, 14-24px arrow 8px after it, width hugs text. Inverts to 1px white on photography. The same box at every level. Print-like and sure of itself, and the cheapest way to look like a car or furniture brand.

Outline with a serif label: 34-58px, radius 0 or full, 1-1.5px ink, 15-21px serif at 400, sentence case, 9-26px padding, hugging the text. Reads as a wine list or gallery label, not a SaaS control. Border and text inherit the section: white on photo, ink on paper.

Pill outline same height as its primary: 32-48px, 1-2px stroke in ink or accent, transparent or white fill, 16/500 label, 20-30px padding. Equal size to the primary, with weight alone ranking them. Inverts to a white keyline on dark sheets. Fill on hover.

No border, just a faint fill: ink at 4-8% or a warm stone tint, 36-40px, radius matching the primary, 14-16/500 ink label, optional thin arrow. It stays visibly a button without competing. Use a warm tint on warm pages so it does not read as disabled grey. Hover to about 12%.

Control over photo or video: 32-53px, fill black at 30-50% or white at 10-20% with blur, 1px white at 12-60%, white 12-15px label, optional thin arrow. Keep it legible on the brightest frame. Hover raises fill and border together in 300ms. Never rely on the border alone over busy pictures.

Secondary on a dark page: 36-44px, radius matching the primary, vertical gradient from about +12 to +6 levels over the ground, or white at 5%, 1px white at 3-14%, 14/500 near-white. Sits one step above the ground, so it is a real object without taking the eye from the light primary.

White key on a light page: 36-48px, radius matching the primary, no border, 0 0 0 1px at 10-16% ink as a ring, 0 1px 3px or 0 2px 6px -1px soft shadow, slightly darker base. 14-15/500 ink label. Tactile on flat ruled pages. Pairs with a lit or top-lit primary.

Ghost button whose border repeats the page's own colour rail: 36px, radius 6, 2px gradient stroke from one hue at top left to another at bottom right, mid-grey mono caps 14/300. It may be the only colour in the nav. Use only if that gradient already exists elsewhere.

Two solids instead of solid plus outline: one colour means buy, a second means navigate. Same height, radius and padding, 16/500. Use for Compare and View all on pages crowded with outlines. Works with inverse pairs, such as dark fill with accent label against accent fill with dark label.

A row of equal quiet chips rather than one secondary: 32-50px, 1px hairline or faint fill, 8-12px gaps, 14px grey label with a real 14-24px logo or line icon. Good for platforms, community links and filters. Equal weight, left aligned. Real full-colour logos may be the only saturation.

An outline that is not a rectangle: a 1px oval tilted -3 degrees like a pen circle, four corner brackets with no sides, crop marks overshooting by 8px, a bevelled plaque. Keep the label horizontal and plain. Use one such shape sitewide, and only where the brand already draws.

A secondary that opens choices in place: 40-44px outline with a chevron opens a 340px popover, radius 8, caret up, 56px rows of real OS logos and 15px labels. It overlaps the content below and spares a separate downloads page. Close on escape and outside click.

A plain link scaled into the object that closes a page: a pill 64-92px tall spanning the container, 20-22px label centred, 1px white outline or one pale fill. Use at the end of an index, for View all. It works because it is the only large control on the page.

Same size as surrounding text, 1px underline offset 3-4px, in ink or at about 30% ink so the line is quieter than the word. No arrow, no colour. Use thickness and offset set explicitly. Hover shifts the underline to full ink. The default link for prose, lists and portfolios.

Two grades of link: 1px dotted underline offset 3-6px for a term or a quiet alternative, solid 1px for a real destination. Grey or ink text, no colour. Terms without a tooltip stay plain, so the underline carries meaning. Good for pricing bullets, docs and dense product copy.

Accent text with a small chevron, no underline: 14-17px at 400-700, chevron 8-10px, 6-8px gap. On hover the chevron grows a stem into an arrow and moves 2-4px right. Place it at the foot of a card, aligned across the row. Works when accent is the only interactive colour.

Ink label with an arrow glyph and no underline: 14-16/500, 14-16px arrow, 8px gap. Direction carries meaning: right changes page, down scrolls, diagonal leaves the site. Stack beneath offers as the only action. Keep the arrow thin and optically aligned to the x-height centre.

16px label with a 1px underline under the words only, and an arrow sitting past the line, 6-8px away. It can replace every button on a page, including the nav booking action. Reads as considered rather than default. Use a deep brand colour instead of blue.

Label beside a circled arrow: a 24-48px ring or tonal disc holding a 12-16px arrow, 8-16px gap, 14-16px label at 500-700. Ring at 1px grey on light, white at 30% on dark. Hover fills the ring or expands it. Quieter than a pill, louder than a link, and the arrow chip recurs sitewide.

12-14px uppercase mono, tracking up to 0.1em, 1px rule 3-4px under the baseline at exact text width, no arrow or fill. White on photo, ink on paper. Can be the main call to action on fashion and technical sites, sitting at the right end of a heading row.

Link set in the editorial voice: 20-27px serif or italic, 1px rule 3px below or none, a 5px solid triangle or small arrow, the verb varying by content. No button shapes anywhere. Isolation or a sentence end marks it. Suits agencies, culture and galleries with strong type.

A link that owns a full cell: label left, arrow flush right, 1px rule beneath spanning the column, 56-80px tall, in rows of two or three. Replaces a card row for secondary destinations. Use 16-30px labels. Hover shifts the arrow only. Reads like a form field or a timetable.

Label sitting on a solid rectangle exactly the text height, no radius, like a marker stroke or an inverted caption: 12-16px tracked caps on a peach, or black on white. Tight padding of 0 to 6px. Same tint recurs in icon chips. Suits portfolios and culture sites.

A plain word with one owned typographic mark and no underline: red parentheses around 12px caps, a trailing solid dot at 0.55em, a leading plus. The mark appears in nav, footer and sections, so it becomes a tiny signature. Use one mark only and keep it the same everywhere.

A consistent docs exit that closes each section: a grey 13-15px Learn or Features label, then a line of quiet links, as 32px hairline pills or 15px grey words each ending in a small +, closing with More. Same position every time. Turns depth into rhythm.

Text alone: 15-20px, title case or caps, no underline, no arrow, no colour, at the left margin under a statement. Works only with strong hierarchy around it, since nothing signals interactivity. Add a hover underline and a focus ring. Best in portfolios and film sites.

evidence.name: Yves Tumor - Safe In The Hands of Love

spec: Square ghost icon button for toolbars and app chrome: 28-36px square, radius 6-8, 16px icon at 1.5px stroke in muted ink, no border. Hover adds a 6% ink fill and takes icon to full ink in 100-150ms. Needs an accessible name and a tooltip. Keep a 44px hit area on touch.

Prev and next on the heading row: two 32-48px circles or squares, 1-2px stroke, 16-20px thin arrow, 8px gap, disabled side at 40%. Optional '01 / 03' counter or a 72x32 grey progress pill between. Align right to the row. The same arrow can return at 24px inside links.

Control on looping media: a 36-40px circle or pill, translucent dark fill at 48-72%, two white bars or a play disc, optional 2px ring that draws playback progress, 14px label and runtime. Bottom right in tiles. Autoplay stays silent, and the chip offers sound. Every clip gets one.

Survey marks instead of dots: six 8px dark squares at 32px pitch, bottom right of the slide. The active tick stretches to a 30px bar that fills with accent as autoplay progress, over a pale track. Each tick needs a 24px hit area and aria-current.

A persistent helper, shaped as the product rather than a stock bubble: a 44-72px disc, a 126-156px white pill with 1px line, soft shadow and a 26-36px orb, or a brand tile 72x80. Fixed 16-40px from the corner. Keep a ring on dark bands so it never disappears.

A tall thin cue: 32-40px wide by 46-80px high capsule, 1px white or 25% white fill, long thin down arrow that draws in a loop. Unusually tall ratio, so it reads as an instrument, not a badge. Base of the viewport or right edge at mid-height. Stops under reduced motion.

One solid shape on an image as its only control: a 60-64px white disc, or a notched tile with stepped corners, holding a thin 16-20px arrow, no shadow, centred or low left. The photo stays uncropped by any label. Hover scales the icon, not the disc.

A 64px black circle holding a thin chevron, straddling the seam between the last section and the footer, half on each. It marks the end of the content and gives the footer a clear hinge. 200ms transition. Use one per page, for back to top or a next chapter.

Small square chip with a custom icon: 16-48px, radius 3-4, one flat fill or 1px border, paired with a 12px mono label 14px to its right, or fixed in a corner as menu and back. Replaces standard buttons sitewide. Corners match the mark, so it reads as a keycap.

Row of 40px circles at about 80% opacity of a warm dark tone, white 14px glyphs, 8px gaps, 200ms transition. Readable on any frame without competing with film behind it. Six at most. Each link needs an accessible name, since the glyph is the only label.

An OS desktop idiom replacing navigation: 70px flat icons such as a folder and a circled i, bottom right, 11px caps labels 26px below. Single click opens. Only for studios and spatial sites where the interface is the concept. Provide a real nav for keyboards and phones.

Two pills of equal height, 40-50px, 16px at 400-500. Primary filled, secondary transparent with 1px border in ink or white at 25%. 8-16px gap, 20-24px padding. Same pair at about 32px in the nav. Label two words or fewer. On dark or photo the outline turns white.

Rectangular pair, radius 2-8, 36-50px, 16/500, 16-24px padding, 12-16px gap. Primary solid, secondary 1px line, pale on light product pages and full ink on print-like ones. Both may end in the same arrow. No shadow or gradient. Stacks full width on phones with the primary on top.

Primary solid, secondary a pale tint with no border, same height and shape: 36-56px, 14-16/500, 8-12px gap. The tint is about 6% ink, a warm stone, or a lighter step of the primary's own hue. Calmer than an outline, since no second line enters the composition.

One container only: a filled button, then a same-size text link in the same accent or muted ink with a chevron, 16-36px gap, sometimes stacked 16px below. One filled shape per screen, so the eye has a single target. The most restrained pair and the safest default on brand pages.

A dark or lit primary beside a white raised twin, same height and radius: 36-48px, radius 10-14, 14-15/500. Primary carries an inset top highlight, secondary a 1px ring at 10-16% and soft 0 2px 6px -1px shadow. 8-16px gap. Tactile and expensive, and it depends on matching metrics exactly.

On near-black, no colour: light fill plus a charcoal fill one or two steps above the ground, same size, 34-44px, 14-16/500, 8-10px gap. The charcoal is about #1b1b1b or white at 5-10%. A third action can sit far right as plain text with an arrow.

Two buttons of exactly equal width and weight, 48-62px, radius 4-14, 16-20px labels, 10-16px gap. Use when both routes are truly peers, such as two sign-in providers or two audiences. Align the pair to the block above. Add a quiet third line for the fallback.

An arrow shape as the second action: a plain label beside a 40-50px white tile or coral disc holding an arrow, or two rectangles each with a 6px triangle pinned far right. The arrow tile recurs as a sitewide link device, so the pair builds a signature.

For developer tools: a real install command beside the button, same height, 40-48px. 13-14px mono, a $ or terminal glyph, a copy icon, 1px line at 10-15%, 12-16px gap. Clicking copies. The command is a true second action, and can even lead. Must be a command that works.

Second action copies a prompt for a coding agent: a 40-44px outlined chip holding three overlapped 24-28px tool icons, 14-16/500 label, a copy glyph or a divider and chevron. 12-16px gap from a solid primary. A current developer pattern, so use only for tools agents really use.

Both buttons are keys: same shape, a 2-4px solid lower lip, 36-50px, 8-12px gap. Primary saturated with a darker lip, secondary white with a grey lip and muted text. Hard edge instead of blur reads as pressable. Add keycap letters on tools, chunky type on education and consumer sites.

Colours taken from the section, not a palette: 48-52px pills, primary filled with the dark tone of the photo and its label tinted to the headline accent, secondary white at 10% with 1px white at 30%. 12px gap. Buttons change per section and never feel imported.

Square solid beside a ghost framed by printer's marks: 36px, radius 0, 14/500, primary near-black, secondary with 1px hairlines overshooting each corner by about 8px and a tiny plus at lower right. No fill. Fits ruled, blueprint pages where lines already run through the layout.

App stores as the pair: 56-64px badges with matched height and radius 8-16, 16px gap, real glyphs, one in ink and one white with a hairline. Or lead with one store as a labelled tile and shrink the second to a 64px icon tile, so one action leads.

Each route is explained before the click: an 18px caption over its own 48px button in two columns, or three or four 58px intent tiles with solid icons. Use when audiences differ and a label cannot carry the difference. Keep every caption to about four words.

Both labels in mono or tracked caps: 40-59px, radius 0-8, 12-16px, tracking 0.05-0.1em, 8-16px gap. Solid plus 1px outline, identical metrics. Inverts to solid white plus a near-invisible outline on dark panels. Keeps a colourful or playful page technical.

Two controls read as one: 40px pills with only a 4px gap, or adjoining segments sharing a border. Use for two modes of the same action rather than a ranked pair. Keep the nav repeat at about 34px. Fill the active or primary side, outline the other.

Fill moves one step only. Measured medians: dark fills lighten +11 L*, white and pale fills darken 4 L*, saturated fills darken 8 L*. 150ms on ease or cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), or an instant cut. No lift, shadow or scale. The default for almost every button.

Fill or whole control fades to 85-88% opacity in 100-150ms, with no colour change. The cheapest response that works on any ground, including photos and gradients. Faster than a tone step to build, flatter to feel. Use on white-on-dark pills and rows of neutral buttons.

Ink and paper trade places: fill, text and border all swap in one 150-300ms move, with no movement or shadow. Outline fills solid, or solid flips to the page colour. Hard and confident. The usual response for square, printed and editorial buttons.

Fill enters from an edge rather than fading: an absolute inner layer at scaleX(0) goes to scaleX(1) in 300ms on cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), with the label flipping colour on the same curve. Works best on outlined buttons. Keep transform-origin left, and let it leave the way it came.

Only the arrow moves. The chevron grows a stem and travels 4-6px right, or a diagonal arrow moves 5px up and right, over 240-300ms on cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), while the fill darkens slightly. The button stays put, so the click target never shifts.

Two stacked copies of the label: the first rolls out and the second rolls in by translateY(-100%), 200-300ms, clipped by overflow hidden, as the fill deepens. Lively but contained. The duplicate needs aria-hidden. Keep it to one element on a page, or it becomes a tic.

Button moves -4px,-4px while a solid 4px 4px 0 shadow appears, 150-200ms, no blur. On outlined pills, -4px 4px works just as well. A hidden plate can shift instead, revealing a second colour beneath. Printed and playful. Use one shadow colour across the page.

The light changes, not the colour: a radial top glow brightens, or a sheen highlight shifts position, 300ms on cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1). Animate a registered custom property so the gradient interpolates. Rare and subtle. It reads as a lit material.

Depth is removed on hover: the lower lip and outer glow drop away and the fill darkens, instantly or by 100ms. The button seems to sink before you click. Fits any button that has a lip or inset ring. Pair with a further 1px travel on press.

For ghost and glass buttons: border rises by about +.10 alpha and fill by +.04 to +.24, 150-300ms, with border tracking fill so the edge never pops. An inset ring can appear instead, adding no layout shift. Motionless. The right answer for secondaries on dark and on video.

Lift with an overshoot: translateY(-4px) and a shadow growing to 0 30px 50px -10px at 14%, 450ms on cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1). Warm and deliberately theatrical. Use once on a page, on a large single call to action. Never on rows of buttons.

A wide white or tinted glow appears, 0 0 32px at 50%, 200ms. Common on dark developer pages and almost always cheapening, since glow is not a material. Prefer a tone step. Keep it for one button on a page already lit by neon art.
